async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the group settings page by clicking the 'Settings' link
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings", exact=False)
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: On the settings page, find and click the 'Members' tab or link
    # Try to find a link with name containing 'Members'
    try:
        members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members", exact=False)
        await members_link.click()
    except:
        # If not found as a link, try as a tab
        members_link = page.get_by_role("tab", name="Members", exact=False)
        await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Add each member to the group
    members = ["patou", "egpast", "westurner", "jontutcher"]
    for member in members:
        # Click the 'Add member' button
        add_member_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add member", exact=False)
        await add_member_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dialog or form to appear
        
        # Fill in the username
        username_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Username", exact=False)
        await username_input.fill(member)
        
        # Select a role if visible (e.g., 'Developer')
        role_select = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role", exact=False)
        if await role_select.is_visible():
            await role_select.select_option("Developer")
        
        # Click the add button to confirm
        add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add", exact=False)
        await add_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for the addition to complete
    
    # No further actions needed after adding all members
